big_case.notes: A Section 1983 excessive-force petition from county deputies (Tenth Circuit) whose lead question, whether video evidence may be weighed at Rule 12(b)(6), is a recurring procedural issue as body-camera footage becomes universal, and the petition claims a Sixth/Eleventh versus Tenth Circuit split. Against that: a paid petition with no amicus support, non-specialist counsel, a fact-bound shooting, an alternative holding below that the videos would not blatantly contradict the complaint even under the rival rule, and a silent denial at the long conference with no noted dissent. Moderate-low stakes: the issue matters to police-litigation practice but this vehicle drew no attention beyond a call for response.
